Independent Peritheos refit of the manually verified Cu column in AIP Handbook Table 4d-12. It is intentionally separate from the Sun et al. source-author Vinet record. The handbook values are rounded derived-isotherm points rather than experiment-level raw observations.

Parameter covariance is not supplied.

<summary>Parameter provenance</summary>

- **Origin of the parameterization:** Kennedy and Keeler (1972), Table 4d-12 and section 4d-2: the refitted isotherm is reduced from compiled shock measurements. Derived handbook rows are not raw observations, but their origin is experimental.
- **V0:** Fixed to the Cu Table 2 experimental molar volume used by Sun et al., converted with the exact Avogadro constant
- **K0:** Peritheos refit to the checked AIP Handbook Table 4d-12 Cu rows
- **K0 prime:** Peritheos refit to the checked AIP Handbook Table 4d-12 Cu rows
- **Fit range:** 25 populated Cu cells, 15-340 kbar
- **Fit objective:** Sun et al. equation (20), unweighted eighth powers of pressure residuals with m=8
- **Reference temperature (K):** 25 degree C (298.15 K), Kennedy and Keeler Table 4d-12
- **Catalog action:** separate Peritheos refit; published source-author coefficients retained unchanged

## Observation datasets

### aip\_handbook\_table4d12\_cu

- **Reference:**

    - **Title:** High-pressure equations of state
    - **Source:** American Institute of Physics Handbook, 3rd ed.

- **Source location:** Table 4d-12, Cu column, populated rows from 15 through 340 kbar
- **Associated EOS records:** cu\_sun\_2010\_low\_vn\_refit
